end.parentNote: Saanvi practised recognising square numbers from sums of consecutive odd numbers and used the L-shaped dot pattern for 5² to 6² and 7². They gave correct answers for the odd-number pattern and the L-shape counts. The relation between consecutive triangular numbers and square numbers was introduced, but their confusion was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, draw two consecutive triangular dot patterns and rearrange them into a square together.
